scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: cd backend && node -e "const express=require('express'); const app=express(); app.get('/',(req,res)=>res.send('ok')); app.listen(process.env.PORT||3000,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log('EXPRESS ARRIBA'));"
